claims.claim: Ten variables and one chi-field formalism unify physics, theology, information, and consciousness as a coherence system.
claims.plain_english: There is a single mathematical equation with ten parts and one special field that ties together science, religion, information, and the mind into one system based on how well things fit together.
claims.evidence_given: The document asserts this as the 'mathematical spine of the framework' but provides no derivation, proof, or empirical data.
claims.what_would_break_it: If any of the ten variables cannot be meaningfully defined across all four domains, or if the chi-field cannot be mathematically or empirically grounded.

claims.claim: If any one variable in the coherence product goes to zero, the entire system collapses.
claims.plain_english: If any single piece of the equation becomes zero, the whole thing stops working.
claims.evidence_given: The document poses this as a rhetorical question ('What collapses if any one variable...?') but does not provide a formal proof or demonstration.
claims.what_would_break_it: If the variables are not truly multiplicative, or if the system can tolerate a zero in some variable through compensation.

claims.claim: The Master Equation is a mathematical theory of everything that unifies physics and theology.
claims.plain_english: This equation is supposed to be a single formula that explains everything in both science and religion.
claims.evidence_given: The document links to a 'canonical page' for the full argument but provides no evidence on this page itself.
claims.what_would_break_it: If the equation cannot make testable predictions in physics or if it contradicts established theological doctrines.

claims.claim: The formalism bridges physics, theology, information, and consciousness.
claims.plain_english: The equation connects the physical world, religious ideas, data, and the mind.
claims.evidence_given: The document states this as a claim but offers no mapping or mechanism for how the bridge works.
claims.what_would_break_it: If consciousness cannot be quantified in the same mathematical framework as physics, or if theology resists formalization.

claims.claim: The coherence product is the central mathematical structure of the framework.
claims.plain_english: The main idea of the whole system is a multiplication of factors that measure how well things fit together.
claims.evidence_given: The document repeatedly calls this the 'mathematical spine' but does not define the product or its terms.
claims.what_would_break_it: If the coherence product cannot be defined unambiguously or if it reduces to a trivial identity.

claims.claim: The chi-field is a key component of the formalism.
claims.plain_english: There is a special field called chi that is an important part of the equation.
claims.evidence_given: The document mentions the chi-field in the title and description but provides no definition, properties, or equations.
claims.what_would_break_it: If the chi-field cannot be given a precise mathematical definition or if it has no observable effects.

claims.claim: The page is a 'short reader-facing interlude' and the full canonical treatment is linked elsewhere.
claims.plain_english: This page is just a summary; the real detailed version is on another page.
claims.evidence_given: The document explicitly states this and provides a link to the canonical page.
claims.what_would_break_it: If the linked canonical page does not exist or does not contain the promised formalism.

claims.claim: The framework is called 'Faith Through Physics' and is authored by David Lowe.
claims.plain_english: The name of this idea is 'Faith Through Physics' and it was created by David Lowe.
claims.evidence_given: The document header and footer clearly state the title and author.
claims.what_would_break_it: If the authorship is disputed or if the framework is not consistently named.
